heading.title: Share of global exchange reserves, global export invoicing and foreign transaction by currency

figures.source_line: Source: Share of global foreign exchange reserves: IMF's Currency Composition of Official Foreign Exchange Reserves Q2 2024. Share of export invoicing: Bloomberg Intelligence FX Strategy Dashboard. Share of foreign transactions: BIS Triennial Survey, Data Portal. Oliver Wyman analysis

new_components.name: per_panel_unit_differs
new_components.evidence: left panel axis headed '%', right panel axis headed 'Billions of US dollars', both ticked 0 to 100
new_components.why_it_matters: 两个面板刻度数字完全相同但单位不同，读值时必须先绑定面板才能确定是百分比还是十亿美元，否则 $17 会被误读为 17%。

new_components.name: unit_symbol_in_value_label
new_components.evidence: labels printed as '58%', '22%' on the left and '$88', '$17' on the right
new_components.why_it_matters: 数值标签自带单位符号，检索字符串必须包含 '%' 或 '$'，纯数字匹配会失败。

new_components.name: multi_category_single_axis_panel
new_components.evidence: left plot area holds two category slots ('Global exchange reserves', 'Share of export invoicing') under one continuous % axis
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一坐标区内含两个语义组，行键需要同时给出组名与货币名，否则 4% 无法唯一定位。

difficulty_notes: 四个值全部印在柱顶，读数不是瓶颈（步骤2容易）；难点是寻址：一个值需要面板单位（'%' 对 'Billions of US dollars'）+ 组名 + 货币名三层键。'Share of export invoicing' 组里 JPY 与 RMB 都是 4%，只给组名和数值无法区分；而 '4%' 在 'Global exchange reserves' 组也不存在，但 '$17' 与 '17' 之间的单位差异又要靠面板标题 'Billions of US dollars' 才能确定。解析器若把左右两个坐标区合成一张表，0–100 的相同刻度会把两种单位混为一体。

suggestions.what_to_add: per_panel_unit_differs（新组件）：同一图内各面板单位不同但刻度数字相同
suggestions.where_to_change: 面板样式字段增加 per_panel_unit，允许每面板独立 unit_text 并在坐标区上方单独排印
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 面板单位一致 vs 面板单位不同 → 单位错配读值率

suggestions.what_to_add: unit_symbol_in_value_label（新组件）：数值标签带 '%' 或 '$' 前后缀
suggestions.where_to_change: 标签格式字段（value_label_format）增加前缀/后缀符号选项
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 纯数字标签 vs 带单位符号标签 → 字符串命中率

suggestions.what_to_add: axis_title_above_axis 与 unit_in_axis_or_title 的组合（裸 0–100 刻度 + 顶部单位词）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题记录拆分为 number/title/subtitle/unit + 单位放置位置字段
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位在轴标题旁 vs 单位置于顶端刻度上方 → 单位召回

suggestions.what_to_add: multi_category_single_axis_panel（新组件）：一个坐标区内并列两个语义类别组
suggestions.where_to_change: 条件行增加“每面板类别组数”，并要求行键同时输出组名与系列名
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单组/面板 vs 双组/面板 → 重复数值（两个 4%）的唯一寻址成功率
